# Pi Harness

Pi Harness is a plugin-first harness for Pi, with a local web console, CLI workflows, and a composable Cordis runtime.

## Start here

- [Main repository](https://github.com/pi-harness/pi-harness) — source code, documentation, and releases.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/pi-harness/pi-harness/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) — current priorities.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/pi-harness/pi-harness/discussions) — questions and proposals.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/pi-harness/pi-harness/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) — development and pull requests.
- [Security](https://github.com/pi-harness/pi-harness/security) — private vulnerability reports.

We welcome code, documentation, translations, testing, plugin ideas, and careful bug reports.
